LanguageData.HE_Hellas_Dory.label: dory
LanguageData.HE_Hellas_Dory.description:
The long thrusting spear of the hoplite, with a leaf-shaped head and a bronze butt-spike.
Requires 5 Hellenic knowledge unless this is your heritage.
LanguageData.HE_Hellas_Toxon.label: toxon
LanguageData.HE_Hellas_Toxon.description:
The Scythian-style recurve bow, short enough to use behind a shield wall.
Requires 5 Hellenic knowledge unless this is your heritage.
LanguageData.HE_Hellas_Meander.label: meander floors
LanguageData.HE_Hellas_Meander.description:
Lay pale stone floors bordered with the endless key pattern of the old temples.
Requires 5 Hellenic knowledge unless this is your heritage.
LanguageData.HE_Hellas_Chiton.label: chiton
LanguageData.HE_Hellas_Chiton.description:
Sew the light pinned tunic worn by every citizen from the agora to the gymnasium.
Requires 5 Hellenic knowledge unless this is your heritage.
LanguageData.HE_Hellas_Maza.label: maza
LanguageData.HE_Hellas_Maza.description:
Barley cakes kneaded with olive oil and honey: plain food that keeps a hoplite marching.
Requires 5 Hellenic knowledge unless this is your heritage.
LanguageData.HE_Hellas_Columns.label: fluted columns
LanguageData.HE_Hellas_Columns.description:
Carve fluted columns and crown them with statues of the city's heroes.
Requires 5 Hellenic knowledge unless this is your heritage.
LanguageData.HE_Hellas_Olympic.label: olympic games
LanguageData.HE_Hellas_Olympic.description:
Every fourth summer the cities stop their wars and race each other instead.
Tradition: Colonists move 3% faster.
Requires 15 Hellenic knowledge unless this is your heritage.
LanguageData.HE_Hellas_Rhetoric.label: rhetoric
LanguageData.HE_Hellas_Rhetoric.description:
In the assembly a good argument is worth more than a good spear.
Tradition: Colonists gain +12% negotiation ability.
Requires 15 Hellenic knowledge unless this is your heritage.
LanguageData.HE_Hellas_Geometry.label: geometry
LanguageData.HE_Hellas_Geometry.description:
Let no one ignorant of geometry build here: measured lines make faster, straighter walls.
Tradition: Colonists build 8% faster.
Requires 20 Hellenic knowledge unless this is your heritage.
LanguageData.HE_Hellas_Bronze.label: bronze smithing
LanguageData.HE_Hellas_Bronze.description:
Cast and hammer the short xiphos and the heavy, forward-curved kopis.
Requires 10 Hellenic knowledge unless this is your heritage.
LanguageData.HE_Hellas_Theatron.label: theatron
LanguageData.HE_Hellas_Theatron.description:
Build a stage and a painted backdrop, and the whole colony will gather to watch the old plays.
Requires 15 Hellenic knowledge unless this is your heritage.
LanguageData.HE_Hellas_Hippocratic.label: hippocratic oath
LanguageData.HE_Hellas_Hippocratic.description:
First, do no harm. Hellenic physicians wash their hands, take their time and lose fewer patients.
Tradition: Surgery success chance rises by 12%, but tending is 5% slower.
Requires 25 Hellenic knowledge unless this is your heritage.
LanguageData.HE_Hellas_Hoplite.label: hoplite panoply
LanguageData.HE_Hellas_Hoplite.description:
The Corinthian helmet, the layered linen linothorax and the great round hoplon.
Requires 25 Hellenic knowledge unless this is your heritage.
LanguageData.HE_Hellas_Theatre.label: festival of plays
LanguageData.HE_Hellas_Theatre.description:
Tragedy in the morning, comedy at night. People leave the theatre lighter and kinder.
Tradition: Colonists gain recreation 10% faster and +5% social impact.
Requires 25 Hellenic knowledge unless this is your heritage.
LanguageData.HE_Hellas_Academy.label: the academy
LanguageData.HE_Hellas_Academy.description:
A grove where masters walk with their pupils and every question is followed to its end.
Tradition: Colonists research 10% faster.
Requires 35 Hellenic knowledge unless this is your heritage.
LanguageData.HE_Hellas_Phalanx.label: phalanx
LanguageData.HE_Hellas_Phalanx.description:
Shield overlapping shield, every man covers the one to his left. The line is slow, and almost unbreakable.
Tradition: Colonists gain +5% blunt and +3% sharp armour but move 3% slower.
Requires 40 Hellenic knowledge unless this is your heritage.
LanguageData.HE_Hellas_GoldenAge.label: golden age
LanguageData.HE_Hellas_GoldenAge.description:
With the library opened, the league enters an age of plays, cures and arguments that will be remembered for centuries.
Tradition: Colonists learn 5% faster and gain +5% social impact and +5% tend quality.
Requires 50 Hellenic knowledge unless this is your heritage.
Unlocked by finishing the nation's story.
LanguageData.HE_Hellas_Lithobolos.label: lithobolos
LanguageData.HE_Hellas_Lithobolos.description:
The engineers of the city measure springs and angles until a machine throws stones further than any slinger.
Requires 40 Hellenic knowledge unless this is your heritage.
LanguageData.HE_Hellas_PowderArms.label: Hellenic powder arms
LanguageData.HE_Hellas_PowderArms.description:
The Hellas way of making a matchlock or a flintlock: the barrel, the lock, the stock and the drill to use them.
Outside your heritage, this can be researched only once Hellas has reached the Age of Powder.
Requires 30 Hellenic knowledge unless this is your heritage.
LanguageData.HE_Hellas_SteamArmy.label: Hellenic steam army
LanguageData.HE_Hellas_SteamArmy.description:
Cartridges, rifled barrels and a uniform: the army Hellas raised when the factories came.
Outside your heritage, this can be researched only once Hellas has reached the Age of Steam.
Requires 45 Hellenic knowledge unless this is your heritage.
LanguageData.HE_Hellas_ElectricArmy.label: Hellenic electric army
LanguageData.HE_Hellas_ElectricArmy.description:
Machine-made arms, a steel helmet and a field uniform in drab: the army Hellas raised when the wires came.
Outside your heritage, this can be researched only once Hellas has reached the Electric Age.
Requires 60 Hellenic knowledge unless this is your heritage.
LanguageData.HE_Hellas_Works.label: Hellenic works
LanguageData.HE_Hellas_Works.description:
The first electric works of Hellas: one machine the nation is proud of, built to its own taste.
Outside your heritage, this can be researched only once Hellas has reached the Electric Age.
Requires 50 Hellenic knowledge unless this is your heritage.
